events.label: Work on the tower began in 1983 and took four years.

deep.text: The builders used steel from a mill near the harbour.
Each floor was lifted into place by a crane on the roof.
Visitors can ride a lift to a terrace near the top.
On clear days the terrace looks out over the bay and the hills.
A small museum on the ground floor tells the story of the build.
The tower is lit in blue on winter evenings.
